Jordan (Sales): Quick handoff for Cascade Therapeutics 12mo term signed. Needs Okta SSO, VPC peering, and a reserved-cost estimate. CFO wants p95 < 300ms. Tagging Aisha to own.
Aisha (CS): Taking this. Short context: expected 6k MAU, workload = summarization + a few embeddings. Pilot requested in 3 weeks.
Marco (Solutions): Ill draft two infra options: dedicated reserved pool + hosted overflow, and hosted-only with caching. Need sustained QPS and avg tokens.
Jordan (Sales): From call: sustained QPS ~20, bursts to 90 for <5m, avg seq ~100 tokens. They prefer predictable latency even if cost is higher.
Ben (Support): Ill prep runbook and dashboards. Recommend cache for repeated docs. Will add p50/p95/p99 alerts.
BillingBot: Finance note: include line-item monthly TCO (reserved vs hosted) and quantization delta. Use internal TCO tool.
Aisha (CS): Action items: 1) Jordan: intro to security lead (today). 2) Marco: ENG-7120 draft + TCO options (48h). 3) Ben: runbook + dashboards (48h). 4) Aisha: pilot plan + kickoff (24h).
Jordan (Sales): Security POC is Lynn Park (lynn@cascade.co). Ill email intro now.
Aisha (CS): Thanks  reconvene here after ENG-7120 is ready. :thumbsup:
